parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description: Returns a list of all Budget Modifications for a project. For more information on the Budget Changes API, see our documentation on [upgrading from the Budget Modifications API to the Budget Changes API](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/tutorial-budget-changes-api).

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique identifier for this budget modification (a transfer between budget line items). Use as the {id} path parameter for the Show, Update, and Delete endpoints.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this budget modification was created, in ISO 8601 format.

from_budget_line_item_id.description: ID of the budget line item that funds are transferred from. Null when the modification only adds to the grand total rather than moving funds between lines.

notes.description: Free-text notes describing the reason for the transfer.

origin_data.description: Free-text reference data associating this modification with an external system record.

origin_id.description: External system identifier for this modification, unique within the company. Use to reconcile with the source system.

to_budget_line_item_id.description: ID of the budget line item that funds are transferred to.

transfer_amount.description: Amount transferred from the source budget line item to the target budget line item.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this budget modification was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

post.description:
Creates a Budget Modification only if Budget Changes are not enabled.
This endpoint will be deprecated at October 16th of 2023. For more information on the Budget Changes API, see our documentation on [upgrading from the Budget Modifications API to the Budget Changes API](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/tutorial-budget-changes-api).

from_budget_line_item_id.description: ID of the Budget Line Item to transfer from. NOTE 1: required if 'Allow Budget Modifications Which Modify Grand Total' is not checked. notes.description: Notes on the purpose of the transfer

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"budget_modification\":{\"from_budget_line_item_id\":348383,\"notes\":\"Transfer money for extra concrete.\",\"origin_data\":\"OD-3483830-2\",\"origin_id\":4903400,\"to_budget_line_item_id\":4034034,\"transfer_amount\":\"4500.0\"}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/budget_modifications", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
